title: Punjab and Sind Bank LBO Result 2026
vacancyDetails: 1000 Local Bank Officer posts in Junior Management Grade Scale-I; online exam result / interview shortlist released
qualification: Graduation and other criteria as per PSB LBO notification; local language proficiency as required
ageLimit: As per Punjab & Sind Bank LBO 2026 advertisement
selectionProcess: Online Written Exam → Language Proficiency / Interview stages → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, category certificate, photo ID, call letter for next stage
howToApply:
1. Visit https://punjabandsind.bank.in
2. Open Recruitment / Careers section
3. Download LBO Result / provisionally eligible for interview list PDF
4. Search Roll Number
5. Download interview call letter when activated
shortDescription: Punjab & Sind Bank LBO Result 2026 out (20 July 2026) for exam held on 10 May 2026. 1000 Local Bank Officer vacancies; check shortlist on bank website.
content:
Punjab & Sind Bank has released the result related to recruitment of 1000 Local Bank Officers (LBO) in JMGS-I.

Online examination was conducted on 10 May 2026. Result / interview shortlist was published around 20 July 2026 on the bank’s recruitment page.

Qualified candidates should prepare for language proficiency test / interview as per bank instructions and keep checking punjabandsind.bank.in.
